Container.Name: Found & Made
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, privacy-first recipe library for importing, adapting, cooking offline, selectively publishing, and printing complete cookbooks. All durable data stays in one appdata directory.
Container.Description: Found & Made keeps recipes private by default and stores its SQLite database, media, exports, print files, keys, and backups under /data. It supports manual and assisted imports, exact serving scaling, Classic/Guided/Merge Grid views, cooking notes and history, public read-only pages, and print-ready cookbook projects. No cloud account is required.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: recipe recipes cookbook cooking kitchen self-hosted privacy pwa
Container.Requires: Enter Public Origin as the exact browser-facing URL before installation. HTTP is intended only for trusted LAN use; use an HTTPS reverse proxy before exposing the app publicly. Persist and back up the complete /data directory.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Found & Made web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, media, exports, print files, keys, and backups. Back up this complete directory.

Config.Name: Public Origin
Config.Description: Required exact browser-facing origin with scheme and optional port, but no path. Example: http://UNRAID-IP:3000 or https://recipes.example.com.

Config.Name: Allow insecure public origin
Config.Description: Keep true only for intentional HTTP LAN use. Set false when Public Origin uses HTTPS.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Numeric user ID used for the non-root application process and /data ownership.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Numeric group ID used for the non-root application process and /data ownership.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for server-side dates and logs, for example America/Phoenix.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy ranges
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated proxy addresses or CIDRs. Leave blank for direct LAN access; never use a broad public range.
